headline.text: Revenue growth is accelerating: guided 4% to 6% vs -1% reported
Management wording (confident vs cautious cues, -1..+1): prepared +0.09, qa +0.82

trajectory.name: Wholesale

guided.text: We now expect revenue to be down low to mid single digits, with Q2 having a sequential deceleration from Q1 due to some unique factors equating to a multipoint headwind, including higher digital promotions in the prior year in EMEA and timing of North America wholesale shipments.

trajectory.note: guided figure read from the sentence, not yet in the ledger

tone.method: lexical cue counts on management sentences; indicative of wording, not a measure of business health

signals.speaker: Paul Trussell
signals.sentence: These risks and uncertainties are detailed in Nike's reports filed with the SEC.

signals.speaker: Elliott J. Hill
signals.sentence: I am proud of the progress our team made in fiscal year 2026.

signals.speaker: Elliott J. Hill
signals.sentence: Through our Win Now priorities, we are elevating the fundamentals of our business across our team culture, innovative product, brand strength, and how we serve consumers in our countries and cities.

signals.speaker: Elliott J. Hill
signals.sentence: And importantly, it is what enabled us to move about 8,000 teammates into vertical sport teams under our new operating model, the sport offense, while also taking meaningful steps to simplify and accelerate our supply chain and technology.

signals.speaker: Elliott J. Hill
signals.sentence: Our renewed obsession with sport and the success of our athletes is fueling energy for our brand and building momentum in our performance business, which grew mid single digits this fiscal year.

signals.speaker: Elliott J. Hill
signals.sentence: We are operating in a more complex macro environment, where we are seeing added pressure on traffic and discretionary spending across our geographies.

signals.speaker: Elliott J. Hill
signals.sentence: That is why I am confident we are building Nike the right way - not for the next quarter, but for the next decade.

signals.speaker: Elliott J. Hill
signals.sentence: And through those networks, we brought energy and a uniquely Nike point of view to sports moments, both big and small.

signals.speaker: Elliott J. Hill
signals.sentence: Our focus now is translating that brand strength into healthier demand, cleaner marketplaces, and sustainable growth.

signals.speaker: Elliott J. Hill
signals.sentence: In FY 26, across Western Europe and North America, we gained five points of running market share in statement footwear, more than any other top-five brand.

signals.speaker: Elliott J. Hill
signals.sentence: The integrated marketplace is one of our most important areas of transformation.

signals.speaker: Elliott J. Hill
signals.sentence: We have been rebuilding our wholesale relationships, expanding our outreach, and improving how we show up across channels.

signals.speaker: Elliott J. Hill
signals.sentence: For the fiscal year, wholesale revenue grew 4%, led by double-digit growth in North America.

signals.speaker: Elliott J. Hill
signals.sentence: And we have also made significant investment in the physical marketplace, refreshing more than 15,000 spaces in wholesale doors around the world.

signals.speaker: Elliott J. Hill
signals.sentence: We are not finished yet, but I am confident our investments in the integrated marketplace will pay dividends for years to come.

signals.speaker: Elliott J. Hill
signals.sentence: We are also investing in experiences in our key countries and cities to accelerate demand.

signals.speaker: Elliott J. Hill
signals.sentence: In basketball, we continue to invest globally from our partnerships with the Chinese High School Basketball League and its 600 teams, to Jordan's The 1 tournament in 20 cities around the world.

signals.speaker: Elliott J. Hill
signals.sentence: In running, we launched the After Dark Tour in Shanghai; it will reach seven cities this fall.

signals.speaker: Elliott J. Hill
signals.sentence: And we are investing in advanced tools and capabilities to improve speed, precision, and reliability in everything we create, from air manufacturing and materials innovation to how we plan, make, and move product to the marketplace.

signals.speaker: Elliott J. Hill
signals.sentence: That is especially important in Greater China, a critical long-term growth market for Nike where we are fully committed to winning.

signals.speaker: Elliott J. Hill
signals.sentence: Our teams in China are executing a comprehensive reset: returning to sport and innovation, taking a more local approach to product creation, and building a territory-level offense.

signals.speaker: Elliott J. Hill
signals.sentence: We are working with partners in evaluating new ways to accelerate our return to growth so we can be more premium, more culturally connected, and move at the speed of the Chinese consumer, with seamless journeys across digital and physical retail.

signals.speaker: Elliott J. Hill
signals.sentence: In the near term, we are executing cleanup of inventory, investing in must-win doors, and where we invest, we are seeing sales increase high single digits.

signals.speaker: Elliott J. Hill
signals.sentence: I am confident in our leaders and our plans to restore long-term marketplace health in Greater China.

signals.speaker: Elliott J. Hill
signals.sentence: It is getting clearer on the role it plays within Nike Inc. and where it will grow, especially with the Chuck Taylor and Jack Purcell franchises.

signals.speaker: Elliott J. Hill
signals.sentence: As part of that focus, we announced that Shai Gilgeous-Alexander has joined the Nike Basketball family.

signals.speaker: Elliott J. Hill
signals.sentence: We are using it to reshape our business, telling a connected story over time, engaging different communities in relevant ways, and building momentum that carries well beyond the tournament.

signals.speaker: Elliott J. Hill
signals.sentence: An epic film called Rip the Script followed, branching off into individual athlete stories, collaborator collections, innovation unveils, retail experiences, and local tournaments.

signals.speaker: Elliott J. Hill
signals.sentence: We have built it this way because the next generation wants to engage with sport on their terms - discovering, sharing, and participating in the story as it unfolds.

signals.speaker: Elliott J. Hill
signals.sentence: This is about deeply understanding today's consumers and building modern, meaningful, and innovative connections with them.

signals.speaker: Elliott J. Hill
signals.sentence: We launched AeroFit in our national team kits to help athletes compete in extreme conditions.

signals.speaker: Elliott J. Hill
signals.sentence: Earlier in the year, we redesigned our Tiempo and Phantom franchises, and before the tournament we launched our new Mercurial in two expressions of speed.

signals.speaker: Elliott J. Hill
signals.sentence: At launch, the Mercurial became the fastest-selling 24-hour launch for cleated footwear in the history of Nike Direct.

signals.speaker: Elliott J. Hill
signals.sentence: We also connected Nike By You to the tournament and team colors to fuel our new innovation.

signals.speaker: Elliott J. Hill
signals.sentence: As we move into fiscal year 2027, we are focused on building on that momentum.

signals.speaker: Elliott J. Hill
signals.sentence: Here's what you can expect from our teams: As we scale the sport offense across more sports, we expect growth to expand beyond running into training, basketball, and ACG.

signals.speaker: Elliott J. Hill
signals.sentence: In the second half, Nike Sportswear will introduce more than a dozen new footwear styles, each with distinct consumer journeys.

signals.speaker: Elliott J. Hill
signals.sentence: And we will continue to invest in how we show up as a premium brand in both digital and physical retail, including a plan to elevate 50% of our Nike Direct owned fleet by the end of the fiscal year.

signals.speaker: Elliott J. Hill
signals.sentence: Matthew helped guide the company through a demanding stretch, and he has been a trusted partner to me and to this team.

signals.speaker: Matthew Friend
signals.sentence: I have truly valued the partnership with you and this team, and I am proud of the progress that we have made together.

signals.speaker: Matthew Friend
signals.sentence: As we close fiscal 2026, we made meaningful progress across the business: rebalancing the product portfolio, driving momentum and growth in performance while reducing classic footwear franchises by more than $2 billion; keeping revenue flat on a reported basis versus the prior year; stabilizing gross margins excluding the impact of incremental tariffs; taking initial steps to reset our cost base and improve operating efficiency and effectiveness; and our balance sheet is strong with substantial liquidity and flexibility to operate as we go forward.

signals.speaker: Matthew Friend
signals.sentence: After a stronger start in March, especially in North America, by mid-April we began to see a deceleration in retail sales trends.

signals.speaker: Matthew Friend
signals.sentence: Our consumer is under pressure around the world, and we can particularly see it having a larger impact on sportswear, which declined double digits in the quarter with a similar decline in retail sales.

signals.speaker: Matthew Friend
signals.sentence: At the same time, momentum in performance sports continued to build, growing mid single digits and delivering positive year-over-year retail sales comps across running, training, and global football as well as other sports.

signals.speaker: Matthew Friend
signals.sentence: We are monitoring marketplace inventory and promotions closely and adjusting buy plans to manage future supply and sell-in with demand and improvement in full-price sales.

signals.speaker: Matthew Friend
signals.sentence: Before I turn to our results, I want to address an unplanned benefit related to tariffs, which was recognized in the quarter and was not included in our previous financial guidance.

signals.speaker: Matthew Friend
signals.sentence: In the fourth quarter, we determined that the financial recovery of claims related to incremental tariffs paid under IEPAA had become probable.

signals.speaker: Matthew Friend
signals.sentence: This resulted in the recognition of a one-time benefit of $986 million, offsetting the IEPAA tariffs embedded within cost of sales that had been expensed through the income statement throughout fiscal 2026.

signals.speaker: Matthew Friend
signals.sentence: For the quarter, revenues were down 1% on a reported basis and down 4% on a currency-neutral basis, reflecting modest growth in North America more than offset by expected declines in Greater China, EMEA, and Converse.

signals.speaker: Matthew Friend
signals.sentence: Nike Direct was down 9%, with Nike Digital declining 12% and Nike Stores down 7%.

signals.speaker: Matthew Friend
signals.sentence: Wholesale grew 1%.

signals.speaker: Matthew Friend
signals.sentence: Gross margin was 49.2%, up 890 basis points versus the prior year, driven by a 900-basis-point benefit related to recovery of IEPAA tariffs.

signals.speaker: Matthew Friend
signals.sentence: Excluding this benefit, gross margin would have been 40.2%, down 10 basis points versus the prior year, which included additional severance costs related to supply chain actions in North America and EMEA we highlighted last quarter.

signals.speaker: Matthew Friend
signals.sentence: We expect these actions will deliver positive operating leverage and gross margin in fiscal 2027.

signals.speaker: Matthew Friend
signals.sentence: SG&A was down 2% on a reported basis versus the prior year, reflecting continued discipline managing expenses while accelerating investment for the World Cup.

signals.speaker: Matthew Friend
signals.sentence: Earnings per share for the quarter was $0.72, and excluding the benefit on tariff recovery was $0.20.

signals.speaker: Matthew Friend
signals.sentence: For the full year, revenue was flat on a reported basis and down 2% on a currency-neutral basis.

signals.speaker: Matthew Friend
signals.sentence: Gross margin was 42.9%, up 20 basis points versus the prior year, including a 210-basis-point benefit related to recovery of IEPAA tariffs.

signals.speaker: Matthew Friend
signals.sentence: Diluted earnings per share was $2.10, down 3% versus the prior year.

signals.speaker: Matthew Friend
signals.sentence: Excluding the benefit on tariff recovery, earnings per share would have been $1.58.

signals.speaker: Matthew Friend
signals.sentence: Looking at our reported full year results for fiscal 2026, you can clearly see that our gross margin slightly expanded while earnings per share modestly declined despite significant investment and nearly $400 million of severance charges made to reposition and create a healthier foundation for our business.

signals.speaker: Matthew Friend
signals.sentence: In North America, Q4 revenue grew 3%.

signals.speaker: Matthew Friend
signals.sentence: Wholesale grew 10%.

signals.speaker: Matthew Friend
signals.sentence: Excluding the tariff refund benefit, EBIT would have declined 1%.

signals.speaker: Matthew Friend
signals.sentence: North America continues to drive momentum in performance, including strong double-digit growth in global football and running, as well as growth in kids and golf.

signals.speaker: Matthew Friend
signals.sentence: Retail sales grew over the first six weeks of the quarter; however, we did see a deceleration in late April which we continue to monitor closely, particularly in sportswear and Jordan streetwear.

signals.speaker: Matthew Friend
signals.sentence: One highlight I would like to note is that our revenue growth and retail sales comp with Foot Locker was positive for the first time in four years.

signals.speaker: Matthew Friend
signals.sentence: Inventory grew mid-single digits in line with our plans, with a healthy closeout mix.

signals.speaker: Matthew Friend
signals.sentence: Importantly, excluding the tariff refund benefit, underlying gross margin profitability continued to improve year over year.

signals.speaker: Matthew Friend
signals.sentence: In EMEA, Q4 revenue was down 6%.

signals.speaker: Matthew Friend
signals.sentence: Nike Direct declined 16% with Nike Digital down 24% and Nike Stores down 9%.

signals.speaker: Matthew Friend
signals.sentence: Wholesale was down 1%.

signals.speaker: Matthew Friend
signals.sentence: We had continued momentum in performance through running, global football, and golf, all of which grew double digits versus the prior year.

signals.speaker: Matthew Friend
signals.sentence: Although digital revenue declined, off-price was down over 50% following aggressive actions to reduce promotions.

signals.speaker: Matthew Friend
signals.sentence: Sportswear declined double digits and sell-through continues to be challenging, so we have tightened buys and moderated selling plans for the near term.

signals.speaker: Matthew Friend
signals.sentence: Total inventory dollars were up low double digits, with actions in place to reduce supply and accelerate liquidation to improve marketplace health.

signals.speaker: Matthew Friend
signals.sentence: In Greater China, Q4 revenue declined 7%.

signals.speaker: Matthew Friend
signals.sentence: Nike Direct declined 14%, with Nike Digital down 25% and Nike Stores down 9%.

signals.speaker: Matthew Friend
signals.sentence: Wholesale declined 19%.

signals.speaker: Matthew Friend
signals.sentence: Running grew mid single digits, and global football and tennis were up double digits.

signals.speaker: Matthew Friend
signals.sentence: Our pinnacle retail expression, the House of Innovation in Shanghai, posted double-digit growth for the quarter.

signals.speaker: Matthew Friend
signals.sentence: We continue to take actions with partners to clean up the marketplace and expect revenue trends in Greater China over the near term to be in line with recent performance.

signals.speaker: Matthew Friend
signals.sentence: In APLA, Q4 revenue was down 1%.

signals.speaker: Matthew Friend
signals.sentence: Nike Direct declined 3%, with Nike Digital down 8% and Nike Stores up 2%.

signals.speaker: Matthew Friend
signals.sentence: Wholesale was up 1%.

signals.speaker: Matthew Friend
signals.sentence: EBIT declined 1% on a reported basis.

signals.speaker: Matthew Friend
signals.sentence: Running and global football grew double digits, with high single-digit growth in tennis and ACG.

signals.speaker: Matthew Friend
signals.sentence: Where we have invested in elevated retail we are seeing a strong increase in comp sales growth.

signals.speaker: Matthew Friend
signals.sentence: Inventory grew high single digits versus the prior year, with a sequential improvement in closeout mix as inventory actions continue across the geography.

signals.speaker: Matthew Friend
signals.sentence: The environment around us continues to be volatile, including evolving tariff policies, ongoing disruption in the Middle East, oil prices, and other factors that could impact operating costs, consumer behavior, and store traffic and retail sales.

signals.speaker: Matthew Friend
signals.sentence: Last quarter, we provided guidance that cumulatively included the fourth quarter of fiscal 2026 through the first two quarters of fiscal 2027 with revenues to be down low single digits, gross margins to inflect positive in Q2, and earnings to be flattish over this period.

signals.speaker: Matthew Friend
signals.sentence: We reiterate our expectation for earnings to be flattish over that time period excluding the benefit from tariff recovery.

signals.speaker: Matthew Friend
signals.sentence: Considering the current macro environment as well as recent sell-through trends, we are taking actions to tighten buys, reduce future sell-in, and manage inventory.

signals.speaker: Matthew Friend
signals.sentence: We now expect revenue to be down low to mid single digits, with Q2 having a sequential deceleration from Q1 due to some unique factors equating to a multipoint headwind, including higher digital promotions in the prior year in EMEA and timing of North America wholesale shipments.

signals.speaker: Matthew Friend
signals.sentence: We now expect gross margin expansion earlier, beginning in Q1.

signals.speaker: Matthew Friend
signals.sentence: We will continue to be disciplined with SG&A management, driving productivity benefits and operating overhead reductions beginning in Q1.

signals.speaker: Matthew Friend
signals.sentence: Specifically for the first quarter, we expect reported revenues to be down low to mid single digits with no expected benefit from foreign exchange, and currency-neutral revenue growth consistent with recent performance.

signals.speaker: Matthew Friend
signals.sentence: We expect gross margin in Q1 to be slightly positive.

signals.speaker: Matthew Friend
signals.sentence: The tariff environment continues to be uncertain; our forecast is based on incremental tariff rates of 10% continuing through the end of July and then increasing to 15% thereafter, as we communicated last quarter.

signals.speaker: Matthew Friend
signals.sentence: We expect Q1 SG&A dollars to be flat with operating overhead declining while demand creation grows high single digits as we invest into the World Cup.

signals.speaker: Matthew Friend
signals.sentence: While the environment remains volatile and it is taking more time for the top line to inflect positively, we remain confident in the actions we control to improve EBIT margins and increase cash flow from operations.

signals.speaker: Elliott J. Hill
signals.sentence: We spent a lot of time this quarter talking about sport - the highs, the setbacks, the pressures that define teams.

signals.speaker: Elliott J. Hill
signals.sentence: With that said, our point of differentiation - what creates authenticity for Nike - is our sport business, and that creates a halo over both of those brands.

signals.speaker: Elliott J. Hill
signals.sentence: It is also what differentiates us from fashion brands.

signals.speaker: Elliott J. Hill
signals.sentence: Nike Running led the way, and as you heard in the prepared remarks, we have had great response with a sharp focus on the consumer, whether it is the product or the investments we have made on the ground in retail with our tech reps, and the results are clear.

signals.speaker: Elliott J. Hill
signals.sentence: Running grew $1 billion over the last five quarters, and we gained five market share points.

signals.speaker: Elliott J. Hill
signals.sentence: We see momentum in training, tennis, golf, and outdoor.

signals.speaker: Elliott J. Hill
signals.sentence: I'll use one example: Serena wore the Radical Air today; that is performance product, and that innovation will start to show up in some of our sportswear as well.

signals.speaker: Elliott J. Hill
signals.sentence: In the second half of FY 2027, Sportswear will introduce more than a dozen new footwear styles.

signals.speaker: Elliott J. Hill
signals.sentence: It is not just going back to the vault and doing old retro shoes; it is leveraging innovation and bringing newness and freshness in new silhouettes.

signals.speaker: Elliott J. Hill
signals.sentence: We are investing and accelerating our local product creation as well.

signals.speaker: Elliott J. Hill
signals.sentence: In the end, it is going to take time to scale, but I am confident in the work the teams are doing.

signals.speaker: Elliott J. Hill
signals.sentence: We now have small cross-functional teams against each sport obsessing over the consumer, taking insights and translating them into a relentless flow of innovative, beautiful, coveted product across footwear, apparel, and accessories.

signals.speaker: Elliott J. Hill
signals.sentence: Nevertheless, I am excited about what the team continues to do in running, where they set it up.

signals.speaker: Elliott J. Hill
signals.sentence: This quarter alone we launched the Pegasus 42 with a full-length encapsulated Zoom Air unit and it sold through well.

signals.speaker: Elliott J. Hill
signals.sentence: Looking forward in running, the AeroFit product that we launched in football is going to show up in running apparel in Fall 2026.

signals.speaker: Elliott J. Hill
signals.sentence: You will see us leverage that innovation across multiple sport categories.

signals.speaker: Elliott J. Hill
signals.sentence: We connected with retailers in New York and have had tremendous feedback on product across sport and culture.

signals.speaker: Elliott J. Hill
signals.sentence: In basketball, the team is bringing exciting dimensions with Caitlin Clark launching in Holiday 2026.

signals.speaker: Elliott J. Hill
signals.sentence: Free Metcon and other performance innovations are doing well.

signals.speaker: Elliott J. Hill
signals.sentence: By mid-April we began to see a deceleration in retail sales trends, which we believe coincided with our consumer being under more pressure, impacting traffic and discretionary spend.

signals.speaker: Elliott J. Hill
signals.sentence: We are seeing a strong bounce back with the World Cup momentum right now, so as we moved into June we are seeing a halo being created by the World Cup.

signals.speaker: Elliott J. Hill
signals.sentence: We will continue to monitor sell-through every week and make necessary adjustments on forward orders.

signals.speaker: Matthew Friend
signals.sentence: Matthew, on the revenue guide, we provided specificity on the first quarter where we expect revenue to be down low to mid single digits.

signals.speaker: Matthew Friend
signals.sentence: The biggest driver in Q1 versus Q4 is the fact that foreign exchange will no longer be a tailwind to revenue.

signals.speaker: Matthew Friend
signals.sentence: The two largest that equate to a multipoint headwind are much higher levels of digital promotions in EMEA last year in the second quarter - and we have taken a massive turn on promotional activity on nike.com and our digital platforms in Europe - and extraordinarily high wholesale growth in North America in Q2 last year related to timing anomalies.

signals.speaker: Elliott J. Hill
signals.sentence: In sport, proof points include running growing mid single digits this quarter and a great launch of the Pegasus 42.

signals.speaker: Elliott J. Hill
signals.sentence: Global football was up double digits and we launched the Mercurial with strong storytelling both digitally and physically.

signals.speaker: Elliott J. Hill
signals.sentence: We have the After Dark Tour for running and investments in basketball.

signals.speaker: Elliott J. Hill
signals.sentence: We will continue to clean up and elevate the marketplace, invest in elevating online and offline storefronts so there is a consistent consumer experience, and deepen local partnerships.

signals.speaker: Elliott J. Hill
signals.sentence: Kathy Sparks is leading that team and I have a tremendous amount of confidence in her and the team.

signals.speaker: Elliott J. Hill
signals.sentence: Overall, I am pleased with the progress we are making in China.

signals.speaker: Matthew Friend
signals.sentence: Our pinnacle retail store, the House of Innovation in Shanghai, grew double digits in the quarter, reflecting elevating retail and focusing on sport in the market.

signals.speaker: Matthew Friend
signals.sentence: As we look forward, we expect revenue trends in Greater China over the near term to be in line with recent performance, and we continue to believe profitability will bottom before sales in this market.

signals.speaker: Elliott J. Hill
signals.sentence: We reiterate that we expect earnings to be flattish over the three-quarter period we guided.

signals.speaker: Elliott J. Hill
signals.sentence: In December 2024 we launched the Win Now actions, which helped us rebuild the foundation of Nike.

signals.speaker: Elliott J. Hill
signals.sentence: The sequence of actions was intentional: start with culture to get the team refocused on sport and growth, reignite the brand to be more emotional and inspiring with consumer connections, then focus on product portfolio to drive a steady flow of innovative, coveted products, and now execute out into countries and cities that matter to us.

signals.speaker: Matthew Friend
signals.sentence: On margins, Aneesha, our performance this quarter has given us increasing confidence that our margins are stabilizing and that we are starting to see a pathway back toward gross margin expansion.

signals.speaker: Matthew Friend
signals.sentence: In the fourth quarter, our margins, excluding the tariff benefit, were down 10 basis points versus the prior year and that was better than how we guided; we had guided down 25 to 75 basis points.

signals.speaker: Matthew Friend
signals.sentence: The biggest driver was discount improvement we are seeing in North America, lower sales-related reserves in North America, lower cancellations, and lower discounts, which gives us confidence that margins are coming back.

signals.speaker: Matthew Friend
signals.sentence: While those were costs largely in fiscal 2026, we expect them to drive margin improvement in fiscal 2027 and contribute to the trajectory toward double-digit margins.

signals.speaker: Matthew Friend
signals.sentence: Additionally, as we continue tightening buys and reducing the order book, we expect a more full-price business and healthier margins in geographies outside the US that are still depressed relative to prior levels.

signals.speaker: Elliott J. Hill
signals.sentence: When we elevate, we see better sell-through and stronger results in both our doors and partner doors.

signals.speaker: Elliott J. Hill
signals.sentence: They have found a strong rhythm and I remain very bullish on North America's ability to continue to drive sustainable growth.

signals.speaker: Matthew Friend
signals.sentence: Ike, to add context, in Q4 North America wholesale growth was reported up 10%.

signals.speaker: Matthew Friend
signals.sentence: I want to make the point that we did not sell in up 10%; a meaningful amount of that revenue growth was associated with lower returns and sales-related reserves, lower discounts, and lower cancellations.

signals.speaker: Matthew Friend
signals.sentence: We have noted fluctuations in retail sales related to factors like gas prices, but overall the progress in North America is furthest along, including improvements in Nike Direct in North America and in digital.

signals.speaker: Matthew Friend
signals.sentence: We are encouraged by partnerships such as Foot Locker where, this quarter, we grew both Nike revenue and Nike retail sales in Foot Locker for the first time in over four years.

signals.speaker: Matthew Friend
signals.sentence: We remain confident in the path forward for North America.
